name: Norbuprenorphine
summary: Norbuprenorphine is a major active metabolite of the opioid modulator buprenorphine. It is a μ-opioid, δ-opioid, and nociceptin receptor full agonist, and a κ-opioid receptor partial agonist. In rats, unlike buprenorphine, norbuprenorphine produces marked respiratory depression but with very little antinociceptive effect.

pharmacology.text: Norbuprenorphine is a major active metabolite of the opioid modulator buprenorphine. It is a μ-opioid, δ-opioid, and nociceptin receptor full agonist, and a κ-opioid receptor partial agonist. In explanation of these properties, norbuprenorphine has been found to be a high affinity P-glycoprotein substrate, and in accordance, shows very limited blood-brain-barrier penetration.

uses.en: It has no medical use of its own. It matters as one of the active substances the body makes from buprenorphine.
uses.zh: 它本身沒有醫療用途，重要性在於它是人體由丁基原啡因產生的活性代謝物之一。
uses.zhHans: 它本身没有医疗用途，重要性在于它是人体由丁基原啡因产生的活性代谢物之一。

sideEffects.en: Unlike buprenorphine, it acts as a full agonist at the μ-opioid receptor, and in animals it slows breathing more strongly than its parent drug does.
sideEffects.zh: 與丁基原啡因不同，它在 μ 型鴉片受體上是完全促效劑，在動物實驗中對呼吸的抑制比母體藥物更強。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与丁基原啡因不同，它在 μ 型鸦片受体上是完全促效剂，在动物实验中对呼吸的抑制比母体药物更强。

fact.en: Its parent drug buprenorphine comes from thebaine, an alkaloid of the opium poppy, and was developed in Britain by Reckitt and Colman in the 1960s and 1970s.
fact.zh: 它的母體藥物丁基原啡因由鴉片罌粟的生物鹼「蒂巴因」製成，於 1960 至 1970 年代由英國的雷克特與科爾曼公司研發。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体药物丁基原啡因由鸦片罂粟的生物碱「蒂巴因」制成，于 1960 至 1970 年代由英国的雷克特与科尔曼公司研发。
